metadata.title: Pop Group Album Cover with Heraldic Filigree

retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for ensemble group portraits framed by ornate white filigree and heraldic symbols over a textured, industrial background.
excludeWhen: a minimalist or clean modern look is required
the subject is a single person without decorative framing

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of six young adults in stylish, eclectic urban attire posed against a weathered, vertical-slat wooden or metal wall. The composition is framed by intricate white decorative filigree and a central heraldic crest at the top, creating a contrast between gritty textures and royal-inspired ornamentation.
coreVisualRelationships: Central heraldic crest anchoring the top-middle axis
Ornate white filigree framing the perimeter and overlapping the subjects
Eclectic urban fashion contrasting with classical decorative elements
Desaturated, cool-toned background emphasizing the subjects' skin tones and hair colors
coreInvariants: White decorative scrollwork must overlap the foreground subjects
A central shield-shaped crest with internal lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects arranged in a layered, horizontal line across the middle ground, varying in height and pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central heraldic crest at the top and the bright pink hair of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central crest down to the group, then outward to the ornate filigree corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and decorative overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted grays and blues in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the filigree and crest overlays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink hair and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white graphics and dark shadows; low saturation in the environment.

letterConstructionRules: Crest lettering is a clean, bold sans-serif
Secondary text is a wide, all-caps serif with high horizontal expansion
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters inside the crest are stacked vertically
Main title text features sharp, triangular serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, stacked sans-serif for the identity mark paired with an expanded, elegant serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic of the bottom text.
Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the crest letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of six young adults in urban fashion against a weathered gray wooden wall, leaving space at the top and bottom for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a white heraldic crest with stacked letters at the top center and intricate white filigree borders that weave around the subjects. Add wide-set serif text in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Crest is centered at the top

mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact facial features of celebrities
Ensure filigree is a generic decorative pattern

mustAchieve: Integration of classical and urban elements

postGenerationChecks: Is the filigree border present in all four corners?
Is the crest centered and legible?
Do the subjects appear integrated with the decorative elements?
Is the color palette consistent with a desaturated urban look?
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble portrait + [Urban Texture] background + [White Filigree] framing + [Heraldic Crest] top-center anchor.
